name: CLEVER
description: CLEVER is a manually curated benchmark of 161 problems for end-to-end verified code generation in Lean, focusing on generating specifications and implementations that are provably correct. It avoids test-case supervision and uses formal verification via Lean's type checker to ensure correctness, establishing a challenging benchmark for program synthesis and formal reasoning.
reputation: A niche but important benchmark for formally verified code generation in Lean, mainly used by researchers working on program synthesis and theorem-proving-oriented code models.
notes: Avoids test-case supervision and LLM-generated annotations; all outputs are verified post-hoc using Lean's type checker.
